subject: Artifactory NG is the main development subject after successful Beta2 CI
body: Current GitHub main is 28842ae4d1c4f907257b24a73012bf5015702f81. Gen7 Runtime Regression Beta2 CI run 37083926151 completed successfully and produced the tested 5.1.0-beta2-zfold7 debug APK (SHA-256 03d9877e134a6cc2b1d1bbe24a0bc3ceba959b67981ad523b2adb593f2036199). Physical Galaxy Z Fold7 validation remains NOT_RUN. The Android/Fold7 lane is parked unless new field evidence requires reopening it. The primary development subject is now Artifactory NG: persistent AgentBus coordination, recursive role continuity, canonical role-package publication, complete forum snapshot/restore, fencing, recovery and Git mirror integrity.
